title: The Galois Group is Cyclic of Order n
content: aut_isCyclic records (from Mathlib's instance for finite field extensions) that Aut(GF(p^n)) over ZMod p is cyclic. card_aut_field_eq is the general counting lemma: any finite field K' of order p^n has exactly n automorphisms, via IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank together with FiniteField.pow_finrank_eq_natCard and injectivity of p^(·). card_aut_eq specializes this to GaloisField p n.
mathContext: $|\mathrm{Aut}_{\mathbb{Z}/p}(\mathrm{GF}(p^n))| = [\mathrm{GF}(p^n):\mathbb{Z}/p] = n$, and the group is cyclic.

title: The Frobenius x ↦ xᵖ Generates the Galois Group
content: frobenius_apply identifies the canonical generator as x ↦ x^p (simp [ZMod.card]). orderOf_frobenius shows it has order n (orderOf_frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic = finrank = n). frobenius_generates is the headline: since its order equals the group order, Subgroup.zpowers Frobenius = ⊤ (Subgroup.card_eq_iff_eq_top + Nat.card_zpowers). This is the precise sense in which the Galois group is cyclic GENERATED BY Frobenius.

title: The Isomorphism Set is a Free, Transitive Aut(K')-Set
content: The three torsor axioms for the post-composition action σ • f = f.trans σ of Aut(K') on the isomorphisms K ≃ₐ K'. nonempty_algEquiv: both fields embed in the canonical GaloisField, giving an isomorphism. trans_left_cancel: the action is free (left cancellation, via surjectivity of f). exists_trans_eq: it is transitive — any two isomorphisms f, g differ by the unique σ = f.symm.trans g.
mathContext: Action $\sigma \bullet f = f \circ \sigma$ of $\mathrm{Aut}(K')$ on $\{K \xrightarrow{\sim} K'\}$: nonempty, free, transitive — a torsor.

title: The Torsor Identification autEquivIso
content: autEquivIso packages freeness + transitivity into an explicit bijection: fixing one isomorphism f₀ : K ≃ₐ K', the map σ ↦ f₀.trans σ is an equivalence Aut(K') ≃ {K ≃ₐ K'} with inverse g ↦ f₀.symm.trans g. This is the concrete meaning of 'the isomorphism set is an Aut(K')-torsor': non-canonically isomorphic to the structure group, canonically only after choosing a basepoint.

title: Exactly n Isomorphisms
content: card_algEquiv_eq is the payoff: between two finite fields of order p^n there are exactly n distinct ZMod p-algebra isomorphisms. Transporting the cardinality of the torsor along autEquivIso (Nat.card_congr) reduces the count to |Aut(K')| = n from card_aut_field_eq. This is the quantitative refinement of the parent's mere nonemptiness statement.

title: Concrete Corollary: Aut(GF(8))
content: card_aut_galoisField_eight instantiates the general theorem at p=2, n=3: the automorphism group of the field with 8 elements is cyclic of order 3, generated by the Frobenius x ↦ x². A small, checkable witness for the general structural result.
